# Example rulings, filed together (2026-08-12)

A worked example of the legacy multi-ruling file shape: several `## Ruling N` sections in
one file, which `doc-id.py migrate` splits one-per-ruling (NT-0019 §4 step 2). This preamble
line is the only content before the first `## Ruling` heading, and is carried forward as
part of the first split ruling's own body — the concatenation of every split output
reproduces this file's body lines in order (Ruling 68, DP-3's class 4).
